name: morning_brief
prompt: Good morning. Run the morning brief: (1) Check Mission Control for any tasks with status=blocked or tagged needs-tyler — summarize them as Tyler's inbox. (2) Check for any in_progress tasks updated more than 60 minutes ago — flag as stalled. (3) Share what the team is working on today based on ready and in_progress tasks. Deliver a tight morning brief to Tyler. Use the mc CLI: `mc tasks list` to get tasks.

name: ideas_review
prompt: Run Ideas Review with full team panel. Steps: 1. Run `mc ideas list` to find ideas with status=ready. If none, stop and say so. 2. For each ready idea, note the full idea title AND body text — both will be used throughout. 3. Call these agents sequentially via the hail CLI, substituting the actual title and body: (a) `hail canopy 'Evaluate this idea for strategic value — Title: [title]. Body: [body]. Worth pursuing? What angle makes it most valuable?'` (b) `hail briar 'Stress-test this idea — Title: [title]. Body: [body]. Risks, scope traps, missing pieces?'` (c) `hail forge 'Structure this as an actionable ticket — Title: [title]. Body: [body]. Return: recommended task title, full description with context + acceptance criteria + subtasks, and whether this is a task or spike.'` 4. Using Forge's structured output as the primary source, write a task description that includes: the original idea context (from the idea body), Forge's acceptance criteria and subtasks, and any critical flags from Canopy or Briar. 5. Create the task via `mc tasks create` with that synthesized description — never leave the description empty. 6. PATCH the idea to status=converted and set linked_task_id to the new task id. 7. Deliver summary to Tyler.

name: backlog_triage
prompt: Run Backlog Triage. Use hail CLI: (1) Run `mc tasks list --status=backlog` to collect backlog tasks. (2) `hail forge 'Run backlog triage on these tasks: [list]. For each: actionable and scoped? mark ready. Needs Tyler? mark blocked with blocked_reason + needs-tyler tag. Too vague? leave in backlog with note.'` (3) For tasks Forge flags as risky: `hail briar 'Quick risk check before marking ready: [task]. Hidden risks or missing pieces?'` (4) Execute mc tasks update calls based on team decisions. Deliver triage summary to Tyler.

name: task_executor
prompt: Run the Task Executor. Run `mc tasks list --status=ready` and find all ready tasks sorted by priority (high first). For each ready task: (1) `mc tasks update <id> --status=in_progress`. (2) Route based on task type: coding/files/execution → use Bash to spawn Claude Code; research/analysis → hail appropriate specialist; quick/coordination → handle directly. (3) Complete the task. (4) `mc tasks update <id> --status=done`. (5) `mc activity log 'completed: [task title]'`. Process ALL ready tasks, not just one. Never mark done without actually completing the work.

name: team_retro
prompt: Run Team Retro. (1) Run `mc tasks list` to collect done/blocked tasks from last 2 days. (2) `hail canopy 'Quick retro: here is what shipped and what got stuck: [list]. Patterns? Process improvements?'` (3) `hail briar 'Same retro data: [list]. Concerns? Failure modes? What to change before it becomes a real problem?'` (4) If either recommends a process change, create a task or idea via mc CLI. (5) Deliver tight retro summary to Tyler.
